title: Link Cleaner
toast.copied_clean: Copied: the links had no tracking tags
settings.auto.about: Before a message goes. When off, only “Copy without tracking” in the message menu cleans.
settings.notify.about: A short notice when tags are removed from a message you send.
settings.site_rules.about: si on YouTube and Spotify, igsh on Instagram, spm on AliExpress, ref on Amazon, ved on Google and others. When off, only common tags like utm_* and fbclid are removed.
settings.unwrap.about: google.com/url?q=…, vk.com/away.php?to=…, l.facebook.com and the like become the address they lead to, so the redirect does not learn about the click.
settings.extra.about: Your own parameters, separated by commas.
settings.try.about: Paste a link or a text with links: the clean one is copied.
settings.kept: Other parameters, such as the page number, a search or the time in a video, stay as they were. Links without https:// (www.site.com, youtu.be/…) are cleaned too.
